player_prompt.intro:
A yi wum {N} zaʼasɩ kɩndɛ kɩndɛ.
Kɔbʊ kɩndɛ, yi kɔtɔ [accept] nɛ yi daŋ *zaʼasɩ ŋmaŋ*, wallɛ [continue] nɛ yi wɛlɛm kɩndɛ kɩndɛ.
Yi daŋbɛ lɛ, yi kɔbʊ zaʼasɩ kɩŋ kɩndɛ.
Yi yiŋ kɩndɛ (reward = 1) **wɛɛ** yi daŋ zaʼasɩ wɛ wɛɛ zaʼasɩ ŋmaŋ wɛɛ.

outcome.summary: You accepted value {value} at draw {draw_num}/{N}. The best overall was {best}. {result}
